description: This file contains the PHP class definition for 'Language' within the OpenCart system, specifically under the 'Localisation' model namespace. The class provides methods to fetch language details from the database, including getting language by ID or code, retrieving all active languages, and caching results.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A model class representing language data within the localisation namespace of the OpenCart system, extending the base system engine model.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves language details by language ID, including constructing the image path based on extension or default server.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Fetches language details by language code, with image path construction similar to getLanguage.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves all active languages from the database, utilizing caching for performance optimization, and constructs image paths for each language.
